title: bn254-pairing-inversion: (6,2) STNFS, run gate, log phase at 1.3125x its modeled expectation: 2^91.284853655

claims.statement: For the full-production bn254-pairing-inversion target, the algorithm of proof.md (with field-map.md, DESCENT.md, KERNELS.md, STORAGE.md) returns (P0,[x]Q0) with e(P0,[x]Q0)=z with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins, and expected total classical work E[W] <= 1+(K/2^64) 2^92.640407781 < 2^91.284853655 units (C=20,000 scalar AArch64 instruction equivalents), under heuristics H1-H4, H-EA, H-FFT, H-R, H-X, H-SEP and H5 with the premise H5m (proof.md Claim and section 9). A run gate opens the run only when a fresh 64-bit coin is below K = 7208705268926730005, the least integer with (K/2^64) x 0.997992 >= 0.39; a closed run is a failure costing 1 unit. In an opened run both individual logarithms run under one combined phase meter of 2^106 units that aborts as failure. Premise H5m: the true expected work of each individual logarithm is at most 1.3125 times the bound of the descent recurrence (2^90.883942 for both logarithms). Under it the ledger charges that phase at its expected work, at most 2^91.276260 units, because the work before an abort never exceeds the uncapped work; and the two-variable Samuels bound of proof.md section 7 on the two independent logarithm works gives P(cap) <= 0.000037 and opened-run success at least 0.997992. Work and success both rest on H5m. All preprocessing, failed trials, aborts, verification and output are charged once for this target; nothing is amortized over other targets.

experiments.purpose: Recompute the field, collection, filtering and cost-ledger arithmetic, including revised PGF-envelope descent and finite ECM-separation assumptions; rebuild returns rounded draft declarations. Arithmetic passes do not establish production hypotheses. part=pgf recomputes alpha=.5 PGF envelopes at psi=0..0.8 step .01 on all862 downward-rounded raw-mu toy observations; part=porttoy redoes an exact whole ball or parent/child/control from fixed seeds. These are scoped toy checks, not production proofs. Default{} also replays all862 PGF observations. part=bw config0..3 replays seven-pad positive/negative diagnostics; part=adaptive_stats recomputes the 171 earlier entered-node PGF strata, which the default run also replays. part=h5 recomputes ADAPTIVE.md's conditional next-relation tables (627 attempts after an earlier failed relation, failure and child-work observed/envelope with root-cluster bootstrap) from h5data.b85; the default run checks the totals. These are toy-scale measurements; transfer to production sizes is H5. part=threshold verifies the judge counterexample and existing171 count tails for the corrected analytic inequality; it adds no empirical joint-law claim. part=plan prints the current 62-row plan row by row (method, windows, radius, mu, psi, phi, retry, work) with the node budget, E[N] and the abort/repeat losses.
